svg.title: SponsorFlow Level 1 Data Flow Diagram
svg.desc: Eight processes, five external actors, and ten logical data stores. Each flow has one arrowhead at its recipient. Repeated actor and store symbols refer to the same entity or store.
svg.text: Decomposition of process 0 | Gane–Sarson notation | Manual decisions and controlled handoff
Finalized Fixed List / saved batch roster
Updated available slots / program status (approval only)
Arrowheads point to data recipients. Repeated symbols denote the same actor or logical store; stores may group physical tables.
Accounting access requires SLE-FHE verification, individual Approved/Ongoing status, Sponsor confirmation and explicit FASSG forwarding.
Figure 3.X. SponsorFlow Level 1 Data Flow Diagram
